page.title: AI Integration
page.subtitle: Manage AI delegates that connect to Snapper via MCP.

disabled.title: AI Integration is disabled
disabled.message: Enable the feature flag in Settings → Feature Flags to manage AI delegates.

list.emptyMessage: Click “Create delegate” to mint one and generate its MCP config snippet.

identity.labelHelpPrefix: The delegate's username will be derived server-side as

scope.heading: Scope
scope.operatorPlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit caller primary operator

caps.heading: Trading caps (all optional)
caps.errorJsonObject: max_order_quantity_per_instrument must be a JSON object or empty
caps.errorNegative: Caps must be non-negative integers or empty.

toast.negativeIntegersError: Caps must be non-negative integers or empty.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke delegate "{{label}}"?
revokeDialog.message: This revokes the delegate tokens and stops its MCP subscriptions. This cannot be undone.

snippet.warningMessage: They will not be shown again. Snapper does not store the raw tokens; once you close this wizard, the only copy will be in your MCP client config.
snippet.snippetHelp: Long-lived AI delegate token (~10 years). The same token authenticates both the proxy MCP server and the watch monitor. To rotate, deactivate this delegate and create a new one.
snippet.baseUrlHelpPrefix: Base URL is derived from this browser's origin +

consent.title: Authorize an AI connector
consent.intro: {{client}} is asking to connect to your Snapper account.
consent.readOnlyGuarantee: Read-only access limited to your existing permissions. This connector cannot place, change or cancel orders.

scopes.snapperRead: Read market data, orders, positions and signals, only where your own permissions allow it.
scopes.offlineAccess: Stay connected without asking you to sign in again.

consent.notApprovable: This request asks for access that Snapper cannot grant. Deny it and check the connector's configuration.
consent.submitFailed: The decision could not be sent. Try again.

replace.title: Replace the existing connection?
replace.message: {{client}} already has a connection with different access. Allowing this request revokes the existing connection and replaces it.

invalidRequest.title: This authorization request is no longer valid
invalidRequest.message: It may have expired or already been used. Start the connection again from the connector.

expired.title: This authorization request has expired
expired.message: Start the connection again from the connector.

accessDenied.title: You cannot authorize this connector
accessDenied.message: Your account does not have permission to manage AI integrations for this operator.

disabled.title: AI integration is disabled
disabled.message: An administrator must enable AI integration before connectors can be authorized.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: The authorization request could not be loaded. Try again later.
